segments.title: Kaiyo Maru reconstruction and wreck archaeology
segments.body: Kaiyo Maru is a reconstruction of a wrecked ship at the Kaiyo Maru Memorial Museum in Hokkaido, Japan. Visitors can walk through the reconstruction and examine archaeological material associated with the wreck. The deck was closed during this rainy visit. Concern about visitors injuring themselves in the wet weather was the suspected reason, although the explanation was unconfirmed.

evidence.note: Describes the vessel as a reconstruction housing archaeology from the wreck. Deck access is closed, with wet-weather injury concerns offered as the suspected reason.
Identifies the Kaiyo Maru Memorial Museum and locates the visit in Hokkaido.

segments.summary: Kaiyo Maru's reconstruction lets visitors walk through a museum ship and inspect archaeology from the wreck.
